headline: Bitcoin fell below $82,000 on Thursday as mixed Tesla and Meta results revived doubts about AI spending, Asian stocks slid and Brent oil passed $112.

market.asOf: BTC, ETH, SOL and the CMC Fear & Greed Index read from CoinMarketCap about 12:00 UTC 22 Oct (19:00 Bangkok).

stories.title: Bitcoin drops below $82,000 as AI doubts, an Asian stock slide and $112 oil hit risky assets
stories.summary: Bitcoin ran up close to $85,000 late Wednesday, then reversed and fell below $82,000 on Thursday. Mixed results from Tesla and Meta revived doubts about AI spending, Asian stocks fell hard, and oil jumped after more Houthi strikes in Saudi Arabia. Smaller coins, especially DeFi tokens, fell the most. Higher oil can keep inflation and interest rates up, which tends to weigh on crypto.
points: Bitcoin fell as much as 2.9% to below $82,000, about 2.7% down since midnight UTC; ether lost 2.6% to near $2,400 and SOL 2.4% to about $104, per CoinDesk at 10:50 UTC (live prices are at the top of the page).
Mixed Tesla and Meta results sent Nasdaq 100 futures down 1.32%, per CoinDesk; Tesla fell 3% after hours after cutting its spending forecast.
China's CSI 300 stock index entered a bear market, and stocks in Japan, South Korea and Hong Kong fell around 3% or more, per CoinDesk.

Brent oil futures were at $111.91, up $3.09 and the highest since 18 May, per Cornerstone Futures (6:45am ET); CoinDesk reported Brent above $112. The US ordered some diplomats out of Saudi Arabia after Houthi strikes.

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs take in $528M on Wednesday, and ether funds end a five-day outflow run
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, took in a net $528 million on Wednesday, led by BlackRock and Fidelity. Ether funds took in money for the first time in six sessions. The buying has not stopped Thursday's price drop, and one analyst told CoinDesk that flows remain volatile.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs took in $528.4M on Wednesday: BlackRock's IBIT $235M and Fidelity's FBTC $212.7M, per The Block. FinanceFeeds puts the total at $524.8M.
Ether ETFs took in $14.9M, ending five days of outflows, per The Block.
Solana ETFs added about $0.6M and XRP ETFs about $709,000, per FinanceFeeds.
Bitcoin ETFs drew about $1.08B over three days, per a KuCoin summary of CoinDesk citing SoSoValue.
Bitcoin's share of the whole crypto market hit 60% on Wednesday, its highest since May, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: The OCC's final stablecoin rule leaves room for platform rewards, and banks push back
stories.summary: The OCC, a federal bank regulator, issued its final rule under the GENIUS Act stablecoin law. It dropped a proposed presumption against stablecoin rewards paid through third parties such as exchanges, so each set-up will be judged on its own facts. The American Bankers Association says this undermines what Congress intended.
points: The final rule drops the proposed presumption against yield arranged through third parties, per The Block.
The direct ban stays: an issuer cannot pay interest or yield to a holder simply for holding, using or storing a payment stablecoin, per SpazioCrypto's reading of the rule.
Calling a payment a "reward" or "cashback" does not exempt it, and every structure will be judged on its own facts, per SpazioCrypto.
ABA CEO Rob Nichols said "attempting to address deposit flight and economic harm after it has occurred is the wrong approach."
The rule applies from 18 Jan 2027, per SpazioCrypto.

briefs.title: Trump says nearly $1B in scam-linked crypto is frozen
briefs.summary: At a White House roundtable on 21 Oct, Trump said authorities had frozen nearly $1 billion in crypto tied to foreign scammers. The DOJ's Scam Center Strike Force had about $938.5M under restraint as of 15 Oct. Frozen is not the same as returned to victims.

briefs.title: About $431M of leveraged bets wiped out
briefs.summary: Roughly $431M of leveraged positions were liquidated in 24 hours, per CoinDesk citing CoinGlass. Bets on a rise made up $210M of the $222M wiped out in the last 12 hours, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Tesla keeps its bitcoin and books a $288M paper gain
briefs.summary: Tesla's Q3 net income included a $288M unrealized gain on its bitcoin. It sold none of its 11,509 BTC.

briefs.title: Money shelters in bitcoin as altcoins slide
briefs.summary: CRV fell 8.2%, ENA 7.2% and UNI 5%, while Monero rose 4.9% to about $651, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Ireland fines Coinbase about €3.25M
briefs.summary: The Central Bank of Ireland fined Coinbase Ireland €3,252,618 for breaching safeguarding and outsourcing rules between Nov 2020 and Aug 2025.

briefs.title: South Korea's crypto law nears completion
briefs.summary: Talks on the Digital Asset Basic Act, covering exchange licensing and stablecoin issuance, are close to done, per The Block. Korea's crypto tax, due 1 Jan 2027, is under review again.

briefs.title: Grayscale lets investors pay in crypto for 10 funds
briefs.summary: Investors can now contribute tokens instead of cash to 10 Grayscale products, including its BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP funds.
